title: Vali's death-time advises
introduction: Vali recovers from his swoon and gives his parting messages to Sugreeva and Angada. He also gives his miraculous pendant, given by his father Indra, to Sugreeva and asks him to assume authority of Kishkindha kingdom, for he won it in this fight. Angada is advised to conduct appropriately for he is becoming a father-less son now. Then Vali breathes his last to pave the way for Seetha's search.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे द्वा विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 22nd chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
वीक्षमाणः तु मंदासुः सर्वतो मंदम् उच्छ्वसन् |
आदौ एव तु सुग्रीवम् ददर्श अनुजम् अग्रतः
verses.iast:
vīkṣamāṇaḥ tu maṃdāsuḥ sarvato maṃdam ucchvasan |
ādau eva tu sugrīvam dadarśa anujam agrataḥ
verses.translation: With his life-force slowing down Vali respired slowly glancing everywhere, and he firstly saw his brother Sugreeva afore him.

verses.devanagari:
तम् प्राप्त विजयम् वाली सुग्रीवम् प्लवग ईश्वरम् |
आभाष्य व्यक्तया वाचा सस्नेहम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tam prāpta vijayam vālī sugrīvam plavaga īśvaram |
ābhāṣya vyak{}tayā vācā sasneham idam abravīt
verses.translation: Vali nodding at Sugreeva, who achieved triumph and became the lord of fly-jumpers, amicably spoke this to him in an unambiguous tone.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीव दोषेण न माम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि किल्बिषात् |
कृष्यमाणम् भविष्येण बुद्धि मोहेन माम् बलात्
verses.iast:
sugrīva doṣeṇa na mām gantum arhasi kilbiṣāt |
kṛṣyamāṇam bhaviṣyeṇa buddhi mohena mām balāt
verses.translation: "Sugreeva, reckon me not by my iniquities, but reckon as one who is all the while forcibly hauled into this futurity owing to my impropriety and obduracy.

glosses.meaning: by fault, to know - reckon me by iniquities
forcibly, me, one who is all the while attracted - hauled, [thus you reckon.]

verses.devanagari:
युगपद् विहितम् तात न मन्ये सुखम् अवयोः |
सौहार्दम् भ्रातृ युक्तम् हि तद् इदम् जातम् अन्यथा
verses.iast:
yugapad vihitam tāta na manye sukham avayoḥ |
sauhārdam bhrātṛ yuk{}tam hi tad idam jātam anyathā
verses.translation: "I do not think that we two are fated to share blissfulness simultaneously, oh, boy, therefore the amity seemly to brothers has cropped up otherwise.

verses.label: 4.22.4b
verses.devanagari:
जीवितम् च हि राज्यम् च श्रियम् च विपुलाम् इमाम् |
प्रजहामि एष वै तूर्णम् अहम् च अगर्हितम् यशः
verses.iast:
jīvitam ca hi rājyam ca śriyam ca vipulām imām |
prajahāmi eṣa vai tūrṇam aham ca agarhitam yaśaḥ || 4-22-
verses.translation: "Such as I am, I am indeed forgoing my life, kingdom, and this immense prosperity and even the unenviable glory which adduces that 'Vali is unkillable,' right away.

glosses.meaning: this, me such as I am - who is going to Yama

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिपद्य त्वम् अद्य एव राज्यम् एषाम् वन ओकसाम् |
माम् अपि अद्य एव गच्छंतम् विद्धि वैवस्वत क्षयम्
verses.iast:
pratipadya tvam adya eva rājyam eṣām vana okasām |
mām api adya eva gacchaṃtam viddhi vaivasvata kṣayam
verses.translation: "You realize that I am going to the abode of Time-god now itself, and hence propose yourself as king of this forest-dweller's kingdom, now itself.
notes: Vali's supremacy does not die with him. Here also he is taking a high profile and he himself is proposing the kingship to Sugreeva, without any grudge or grouse, on two counts. One, Sugreeva is the triumphant one and thus he shall get the kingdom forthwith, not Angada, as proposed by Hanuma. Next, Sugreeva is the next best choice for the kingship, rather than Angada, and a younger brother and also as a one-time prince regent. In either way the dying Vali is keeping his nobility high up, as an unrivalled champion and even as an elderly brother.

glosses.meaning: Time-god's, abode, one who is going to

verses.devanagari:
अस्याम् त्वम् अहम् अवस्थायाम् वीर वक्ष्यामि यद् वचः |
यदि अपि असुकरम् राजन् कर्तुम् एव तद् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
asyām tvam aham avasthāyām vīra vakṣyāmi yad vacaḥ |
yadi api asukaram rājan kartum eva tad arhasi
verses.translation: "Oh, valiant Sugreeva, it will be apt of you to make happen the word I am going to say even in such a situation in which now I am, and oh, king, even if that word of mine is infeasible.

glosses.meaning: I, which, word, going to speak

verses.devanagari:
सुखार्हम् सुख संवृद्धम् बालम् एनम् अबालिशम् |
बाष्प पूर्ण मुखम् पश्य भूमौ पतितम् अंगदम्
verses.iast:
sukhārham sukha saṃvṛddham bālam enam abāliśam |
bāṣpa pūrṇa mukham paśya bhūmau patitam aṃgadam
verses.translation: "Have a look at this Angada, who is privileged for all happiness, brought up in all comforts, though a boy he is mannerly, and who with his tear-filled face fallen onto ground.

glosses.meaning: at this, Angada, have a look at.

verses.devanagari:
मम प्राणैः प्रियतरम् पुत्रम् पुत्रम् इव औरसम् |
मया हीनम् अहीनार्थम् सर्वतः परिपालय
verses.iast:
mama prāṇaiḥ priyataram putram putram iva aurasam |
mayā hīnam ahīnārtham sarvataḥ paripālaya
verses.translation: "More dear than my own lives is my son, and when he is deprived of me you have to foster him as if he is your own son, with no resources becoming sparse in every way.

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् अपि अस्य पिता दाता च परित्राता च सर्वतः |
भयेषु अभयदः चैव यथा अहम् प्लवगेश्वर
verses.iast:
tvam api asya pitā dātā ca paritrātā ca sarvataḥ |
bhayeṣu abhayadaḥ caiva yathā aham plavageśvara
verses.translation: "Oh, king of fly-jumpers, as with me you too are his father, patron, an overall protector from all sides, and also thus an assurer in fear.

glosses.meaning: from all sides, overall, protector, also
in fear, assurance, giver, also thus.

verses.devanagari:
एष तारात्मजः श्रीमान् त्वया तुल्य पराक्रमः |
रक्षसाम् च वधे तेषाम् अग्रतः ते भविष्यति
verses.iast:
eṣa tārātmajaḥ śrīmān tvayā tulya parākramaḥ |
rakṣasām ca vadhe teṣām agrataḥ te bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "This admirable son of Tara is a coequal of yours in triumphs, and in eliminating those demons he will be in your advance guard.

glosses.meaning: your, in fore, he will be - will be in advance guard.

verses.devanagari:
अनुरूपाणि कर्माणि विक्रम्य बलवान् रणे |
करिष्यति एष तारेयः तरस्वी तरुणो अंगदः
verses.iast:
anurūpāṇi karmāṇi vikramya balavān raṇe |
kariṣyati eṣa tāreyaḥ tarasvī taruṇo aṃgadaḥ
verses.translation: "This mighty and sinewy son of Tara is youthful, and on overtaking in war this Angada will undertake actions seemly for a son of mine.

glosses.meaning: reflective [of me, seemly for my son,] actions

verses.devanagari:
सुषेण दुहिता च इयम् अर्थ सूक्ष्म विनिश्चये |
औत्पातिके च विविधे सर्वतः परिनिष्ठिता
verses.iast:
suṣeṇa duhitā ca iyam artha sūkṣma viniścaye |
autpātike ca vividhe sarvataḥ pariniṣṭhitā
verses.translation: "In deciding meanings in all their subtleties and also in presages of diverse nature this daughter of Sushena, Tara, is an insightful one in every way.
notes: A parable is said about SusheNa, who is now being called as Tara's father. Tara is said to be the outcome from the churning of Milky Ocean by gods and demons, and she emerged as one among many items that emerged from that Milky Ocean. Seeing her and knowing her as the descendent of Brihaspati, the Jupiter, Vali and Sushena have held her by her hand. Vali held her by her right hand and Sushena held her by her left hand and started to quarrel for her wifedom. Then the elderly sages and gods intervened and decided that one who held her by her right hand is her husband and the other who held her by her left hand is her father. Thus Sushena is said to have become the father of Tara.

glosses.meaning: this one, also - this Tara, also
in every way, an insightful one.

verses.devanagari:
यद् एष साधु इति ब्रूयात् कार्यम् तन् मुक्त संशयम् |
न हि तारा मतम् किंचित् अन्यथा परिवर्तते
verses.iast:
yad eṣa sādhu iti brūyāt kāryam tan muk{}ta saṃśayam |
na hi tārā matam kiñcit anyathā parivartate
verses.translation: "Whatever is said by her as proper that is doable indubitably, indeed nothing contrary happens to her opinions, in the least.

glosses.meaning: by her, which, proper, thus, is said

verses.devanagari:
राघवस्य च ते कार्यम् कर्तव्यम् अविशंकया |
स्यात् अधर्मो हि अकरणे त्वाम् च हिंस्यात् अमानितः
verses.iast:
rāghavasya ca te kāryam kartavyam aviśaṃkayā |
syāt adharmo hi akaraṇe tvām ca hiṃsyāt amānitaḥ
verses.translation: "You have to accomplish Raghava's mission undoubtedly, and if it is unaccomplished there will be infraction on your part because you befriended him before an altar of fire, and you may even be punished for dishonouring him and your given word to him.

glosses.meaning: without, too much, doubt - without a shadow of doubt

verses.devanagari:
इमाम् च मालाम् आधत्स्व दिव्याम् सुग्रीव कांचनीम् |
उदारा श्रीः स्थिता हि अस्याम् संप्रजह्यात् मृते मयि
verses.iast:
imām ca mālām ādhatsva divyām sugrīva kāṃcanīm |
udārā śrīḥ sthitā hi asyām samprajahyāt mṛte mayi
verses.translation: "The bounteous goddess of triumph ensconced in this golden pendant will completely leave it off on my death, avoiding the flaw of touching a corpse, isn't it... hence oh, Sugreeva, you wear it." Thus Vali spoke to Sugreeva.
notes: Sugreeva may not inherit any fortune of invincibility from this invincible pendant, but Vali has to safeguard it without getting into an insulting touch of his dead body śava sparśa doṣa. As such, he is giving it Sugreeva, in preference to Angada.

verses.devanagari:
इति एवम् उक्तः सुग्रीवो वालिना भ्रातृ सौहृदात् |
हर्षम् त्यक्त्वा पुनर् दीनो ग्रह ग्रस्त इव उडु राट्
verses.iast:
iti evam uk{}taḥ sugrīvo vālinā bhrātṛ sauhṛdāt |
harṣam tyak{}tvā punar dīno graha grasta iva uḍu rāṭ
verses.translation: Thus, that way when Vali spoke to Sugreeva with brotherly kind-heartedness, Sugreeva again waned away forgoing his spiritedness, like the lord of stars, namely the Moon, when eaten away by the planet, namely Rahu, during lunar eclipse.
notes: Mythologically there are two planets called Raahu and Ketu in Indian astrology. These two have no counterparts in western astrology. These two are neither gods, nor demons, not planets. At the time of churning Milky Ocean one demon had a share of amR^ita, the Divine nectar. But on noticing it the Sun and Moon report that episode to Vishnu. Vishnu slits that demon's throat with his disc. Then that Rahu became a two-piece entity, one with head, named as Raahu and the other with trunk - tail, named as Ketu. Because Sun and Moon reported the wrongdoing of this two-piece entity, that entity prays to subsist on eating away Sun and Moon. That prayer is granted subject to condition, that this eating will be done only occasionally. Those are the occasions of eclipses of either Sun or Moon. Recent astrology gave names to these two entities as 'Dragon with Head' is Raahu and the 'Dragon with Tail' is Ketu.

glosses.meaning: thus, that way, who is spoken
joy, leaving off [joy of winning Vali]
by [Rahu, eclipsing,] planet, eaten, star's, lord [moon,] as with - he became.

verses.devanagari:
तत् वालि वचनात् शान्तः कुर्वन् युक्तम् अतंद्रितः |
जग्राह सो अभ्यनुज्ञातो मालाम् ताम् चैव कांचनीम्
verses.iast:
tat vāli vacanāt śāntaḥ kurvan yuk{}tam ataṃdritaḥ |
jagrāha so abhyanujñāto mālām tām caiva kāṃcanīm
verses.translation: Quietened by Vali's words and conducting himself befittingly and attentively in the given situation, Sugreeva has then taken that golden chain only when Vali authorised him.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् मालाम् कांचनीम् दत्त्वा वाली दृष्ट्वा आत्मजम् स्थितम् |
संसिद्धः प्रेत्य भावाय स्नेहात् अंगदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tām mālām kāṃcanīm dattvā vālī dṛṣṭvā ātmajam sthitam |
saṃsiddhaḥ pretya bhāvāya snehāt aṃgadam abravīt
verses.translation: On giving away that golden pendant, and on seeing his son who is available nearby, readying himself towards his end that is setting in, Vali affectionately spoke to Angada.

glosses.meaning: available [nearby,] his son, also, on seeing
to lay down his life, resolved to, readying himself

verses.devanagari:
देश कालौ भजस्व अद्य क्षममाणः प्रिय अप्रिये |
सुख दुःख सहः काले सुग्रीव वशगो भव
verses.iast:
deśa kālau bhajasva adya kṣamamāṇaḥ priya apriye |
sukha duḥkha sahaḥ kāle sugrīva vaśago bhava
verses.translation: "From now on, observing time and place you have to tolerate pain or pleasure, endure mirth or misery on your going under the control of Sugreeva.
notes: The vividness of the above parting message is: "On your going under the control of Sugreeva, whether his orders are pleasant or unpleasant to you, you have to execute them enduringly, for you have to conduct yourself according to time and place of your locus standi, and also you have to endure the mirth or misery caused at his behest... for you are no more independent from now on..."

glosses.meaning: of place, time, be observant of
Sugreeva's, control, go into - abide by, you be.

verses.devanagari:
यथा हि त्वम् महाबाहो लालितः सततम् मया |
न तथा वर्तमानम् त्वाम् सुग्रीवो बहु मन्यते
verses.iast:
yathā hi tvam mahābāho lālitaḥ satatam mayā |
na tathā vartamānam tvām sugrīvo bahu manyate
verses.translation: "Oh dextrous Angada, as to how I have entertained you in whichever way you conducted yourself with me, Sugreeva may not approve of such a puerile behaviour of yours, if you resort to it.

glosses.meaning: you, always, by me, as to how
you, Sugreeva, may not, approve of it.

verses.devanagari:
ना अस्य अमित्रैः गतम् गच्छेः मा शत्रुभिः अरिंदम |
भर्तुः अर्थ परो दान्तः सुग्रीव वशगो भव
verses.iast:
nā asya amitraiḥ gatam gaccheḥ mā śatrubhiḥ ariṃdama |
bhartuḥ artha paro dāntaḥ sugrīva vaśago bhava
verses.translation: "Do not reach at his unfriendly ones, nor come near his enemies, oh, enemy-destroyer Angada, you shall be in the control of Sugreeva attending to the purposes of your lord with self-control.

glosses.meaning: in Sugreeva's, control, you shall be.

verses.devanagari:
न च अतिप्रणयः कार्यः कर्तव्यो अप्रणयः च ते |
उभयम् हि महादोषम् तस्मात् अंतर दृक् भव
verses.iast:
na ca atipraṇayaḥ kāryaḥ kartavyo apraṇayaḥ ca te |
ubhayam hi mahādoṣam tasmāt aṃtara dṛk bhava
verses.translation: "Do not conduct yourself with excessive friendliness or unfriendliness, as this pair of opposites itself has a flaw, therefore you cultivate an intermediary outlook." Vali thus spoke to Angada.

glosses.meaning: for you, not, to be done
non, affinity, also, [na] kartavyaH = [not] to be done
therefore, intermediary, in outlook, you be - you cultivate.

verses.devanagari:
इति उक्त्वा अथ विवृत्त अक्षः शर संपीडितो भृशम् |
विवृतैः दशनैः भीमैः बभूव उत्क्रान्त जीवितः
verses.iast:
iti uk{}tvā atha vivṛtta akṣaḥ śara sampīḍito bhṛśam |
vivṛtaiḥ daśanaiḥ bhīmaiḥ babhūva ut.hkrānta jīvitaḥ
verses.translation: He who is highly tortured by the arrow of Rama spoke to Angada in that way, and afterwards his eyeballs rolled-up, mouth hung open baring his horrid teeth, and his life too took to flight from his body.

glosses.meaning: wide, opened [mouth hung open baring,] horrid, teeth
took wings, who has his life - whose life took to flight

verses.devanagari:
ततो विचुक्रुशुर् तत्र वानरा हत यूथपाः |
परिदेवयमानाः ते सर्वे प्लवग सत्तमाः
verses.iast:
tato vicukruśur tatra vānarā hata yūthapāḥ |
paridevayamānāḥ te sarve plavaga sattamāḥ
verses.translation: Then, all those best monkeys avaialble there have started to weep when their monkey chief is dead, and for that matter they have loudly squawked at his death in this way.

glosses.meaning: those that have a dead, chief
in that matter of Vali's death

verses.devanagari:
किष्किन्धा हि अथ शून्या च स्वर् गते वानरेश्वरे |
उद्यानानि च शून्यानि पर्वताः कानानि च
हते प्लवग शार्दूले निष् प्रभा वानराः कृताः |
verses.iast:
kiṣkindhā hi atha śūnyā ca svar gate vānareśvare |
udyānāni ca śūnyāni parvatāḥ kānāni ca
hate plavaga śārdūle niṣ prabhā vānarāḥ kṛtāḥ |
verses.translation: "When the lord of monkeys departed to heaven Kishkindha is indeed rendered derelict, dreary are the gardens, deserted are the mountains and forests as well, and when the tiger among fly-jumpers is dead all the vanara-s are rendered up into a lacklustre life.

glosses.meaning: monkey's, lord, on going, to heaven
Kishkindha, is now, empty - derelict, indeed
mountains, forests, as well as [are void]
without, brightness - lacklustre, they are made led into a lacklustre life.

verses.devanagari:
यस्य वेगेन महता काननानि वनानि च
पुष्प ओघेण अनुबद्धन्ते करिष्यति तत् अद्य कहः |
verses.iast:
yasya vegena mahatā kānanāni vanāni ca
puṣpa ogheṇa anubaddhante kariṣyati tat adya kahaḥ |
verses.translation: "And by the impetus of whose great rapidity flowers available in forests and woodlands used to shower on him in torrents and enwreathe him from behind, that Vali is no more, and now who has got such an impetus?
notes: This verse also means: "He who has perfected the gardens and forests with full of flowers and thereby with fruits on which the monkeys subsist, and now who can make these areas so fructified to let all the monkeys thrive?"

This flowers following Vali - is the same situation with Hanuma when he jumps from Mt. Mahendra to Lanka. A volley of flowers shower on him owing to kick-start and follow him up to some distance into ocean, as though to worship him.

glosses.meaning: whose, by great, rapidity - by impetus of it
trailed after, bindingly - flowers followed and enwreathe him
now, who, can do - who has such impetus.

verses.devanagari:
येन दत्तम् महत् युद्धम् गन्धर्वस्य महात्मनः
गोलभस्य महाबाहुः दश वर्षाणि पंच च |
न एव रात्रौ न दिवसे तत् युद्धम् उपशाम्यति
verses.iast:
yena dattam mahat yuddham gandharvasya mahātmanaḥ
golabhasya mahābāhuḥ daśa varṣāṇi paṃca ca |
na eva rātrau na divase tat yuddham upaśāmyati
verses.translation: "By which great-souled Vali a ferocious duel was given to the celestial, namely the great armed Golabha, which did not cease either in the daytime or night till Vali felled Golabha, that Vali is no more.
notes: This Sanskrit expression 'giving a duel' is the same that is available in English like - 'give me a duel.' etc.

glosses.meaning: by which, great souled one - Vali
great armed, Golabha's, to gandharva / celestial

verses.devanagari:
ततः षोडशमे वर्षे गोलभो विनिपातितः |
तम् हत्वा दुर्विनीतिम् तु वाली दंष्ट्र करालवान् |
सर्वा अभयम् करः अस्माकम् कथम् एष निपातितः
verses.iast:
tataḥ ṣoḍaśame varṣe golabho vinipātitaḥ |
tam hatvā durvinītim tu vālī daṃṣṭra karālavān |
sarvā abhayam karaḥ asmākam katham eṣa nipātitaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, in the sixteenth year Vali unquestionably felled Golabha, and on killing that evil-minded Golabha with his zigzag teeth Vali accorded fearlessness to all of us, how such a Vali is felled now?" Thus the monkeys raised hue and cry.

glosses.meaning: teeth, one with sawteeth, zigzagged teet
to all of us, no, fear, accorder

verses.devanagari:
हते तु वीरे प्लवगाधिपे तदा
प्लवंगमाः तत्र न शर्म लेभिरे |
वने चराः सिंह युते महावने
यथा हि गावो निहते गवाम् पतौ
verses.iast:
hate tu vīre plavagādhipe tadā
plavaṅgamāḥ tatra na śarma lebhire |
vane carāḥ siṃha yute mahāvane
yathā hi gāvo nihate gavām patau
verses.translation: But when that fly-jumper's brave lord Vali is killed, those fly-jumpers have gone into a freneticness in that matter of Vali's killing, as with the cows becoming frenetic when their husbanding bull is killed while moving in a great forest that is riddled with a lion.

glosses.meaning: lion, possessing with - in great forests a in a lion riddled forest
in forest, moving, cows, as with
brave one, monkeys', lord, when killed, but
fly-jumpers, quietude, not, obtained - went into a freneticness.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तु तारा व्यसन अर्णव प्लुता
मृतस्या भर्तुर् वदनम् समीक्ष्य सा |
जगाम भूमिम् परिरभ्य वालिनम्
महा द्रुमम् छिन्नम् इव आश्रिता लता
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu tārā vyasana arṇava plutā
mṛtasyā bhartur vadanam samīkṣya sā |
jagāma bhūmim parirabhya vālinam
mahā drumam chinnam iva āśritā latā
verses.translation: But then Tara, whelmed under a ocean called affliction closely observed her dead husband's face, embraced him and collapsed onto ground as with any creeper plant when the giant tree on which it is hinging is hacked down.

glosses.meaning: dead, husband's, face, closely, on observing
Vali, embraced, onto earth, gone - collapsed.
